name: Starbucks
kurzbeschreibung:
**Starbucks in Innsbruck**

Discover the perfect blend of global coffee culture and Alpine charm at **Starbucks in Innsbruck**. Whether you're exploring the historic **Altstadt**, taking in the breathtaking views from the **Nordkette**, or strolling along the **Inn River**, our cafés offer a cozy retreat to recharge.

Sip on your favorite espresso, enjoy a **Kaffee mit Schlag** (coffee with whipped cream), or indulge in one of our seasonal specialties—all while soaking in the unique atmosphere of **Tirol’s** capital.

Find us at:
- **Starbucks Innsbruck Hauptbahnhof** – Right at the main train station, ideal for travelers and commuters.
- **Starbucks Innsbruck Maria-Theresien-Straße** – In the heart of the city, perfect for a midday break.
- **Starbucks Innsbruck Bergisel** – Near the iconic **Bergisel**, offering stunning panoramic views.

Visit us and experience **Starbucks** with a **Tiroler** twist! ☕️⛰️
